title: Real materials · Meridiana and Alegia
description: The geo places with real materials (docs/environment-styling.md § Real materials): the Meridiana's grey panot, new asphalt, plaster grain under the painted bays and the drinking fountains from the map; Alegia's terracotta roofs, stone plinths and render. Close crops show the surfaces; the last shot times both streets (frame, CPU, GPU, draw calls) like gpu-perf, so the cost of the textures is measured where they are drawn. Run with --gpu --perf for the timings.

steps.eval: window.perf = (label, ms = 5000) => new Promise(done => { const app = window.gerard.game.app, device = app.graphicsDevice, profiler = device.gpuProfiler, s = []; if (profiler) profiler.enabled = true; let start = 0; const begin = () => { start = performance.now(); }; const end = () => s.push([app.stats.frame.ms, performance.now() - start, profiler?.frameTime, app.stats.drawCalls.total]); app.on('frameupdate', begin); app.on('frameend', end); setTimeout(() => { app.off('frameupdate', begin); app.off('frameend', end); s.splice(0, 5); const n = s.length, mean = i => { const v = s.map(x => x[i]).filter(x => x !== undefined); return v.length ? v.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / v.length : NaN; }, worst = s.map(x => x[0]).sort((a, b) => a - b)[Math.floor(n * .95)]; const r = { label, backend: device.isWebGPU ? 'WebGPU' : 'WebGL2', fps: +(1000 / mean(0)).toFixed(1), frameMs: +mean(0).toFixed(2), p95Ms: +worst.toFixed(2), cpuMs: +mean(1).toFixed(2), gpuMs: +mean(2).toFixed(2), draws: Math.round(mean(3)) }; (window.perfResults ??= []).push(r); console.log('perf ' + JSON.stringify(r)); done(); }, ms); })
